Subject: Need help with a divorce by mutual consent case

Hello, my name is Ananya Kulkarni. I am a 40-year-old farmer living in Coimbatore. My spouse Harish Jadhav and I want a divorce by mutual consent with a settlement of 31 lakh rupees, and the couple has a young child. My case number is Petition No. 2215/2020 in the Family Court at Coimbatore. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on 71962 46846 or email ananya.kulkarni56@example.in.
